title: ProtocolV1Packet
description: RehabBridge NEXUS / H10 Protocol v1 newline-delimited JSON stream packet

t_ms.description: Milliseconds elapsed on device since boot (uint32)

flex.description: Raw ADC conversion counts for configured flex channels

fsr.description: Raw ADC conversion count for FSR contact sensor, or null if unsupported

imu.description: Raw int16 readings [ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz]

fsr_ok.description: FSR sensor health and I2C/ADC continuity

imu_ok.description: IMU sensor health and I2C continuity

flags.description: Bitmask: bit 0 = calib loaded, bit 1 = stream active, bit 2 = operator marker pending
